en.why: The screen holds only a cursor and one line of small text, with a great deal of empty space. Typing pauses 0.3–0.5s between words like real keystrokes, and deleting is twice as fast as typing, which splits the product name and the launch status into two beats. The font is the same monospace used for the numbered labels in the product UI.
spec: Timing

Film 11s: first line typed 0.17–4.51s (typo 'bakcoff' 1.2–1.57s, five backspaces 2.1–2.27s, retype 2.47–2.77s); hold 0.7s; delete 32 characters 5.21–5.9s; check mark and '214 tests passing' 6.47–7.77s; hold 0.4s; delete 8.17–8.43s; wordmark typed 8.63–9.0s; green cursor and tagline 9.43s; hold to 11s
Easing

No tweening: each character is an opacity hard set (tl.set) on a fixed 33.6px monospace grid; the cursor is solid on every keystroke, then 0.5s on / 0.5s off in idle gaps; slow drift scale 1→1.04 linear
Camera
Fixed; the line is left-anchored at x 240px and grows to the right; the terminal line drifts scale 1→1.04 over 8.53s and the wordmark 1→1.035 over 2.47s (linear)
Subject

Typing gaps 0.04–0.11s (about 9–25 characters per second) with 0.3–0.5s pauses between words; backspace 0.04s per character for the typo, 0.022s for the whole line, 0.015s for the status line; a solid white block cursor (33.6×66px) follows the end of the text; a 15-name feature rail at 13% opacity scrolls up 380px behind the line
Sync

A muted label 'TALON 2.4 / AGENT' (28px) appears at 0.15s and clears at 8.15s; the rail fades in at 0.9s and out at 8.05s; at 9.43s the cursor turns green #3ddc97 on the same frame the tagline appears
Style
Near-black #09090c background; JetBrains Mono 56px (5.2% of frame height) in #f2f2f4, prompt prefix in muted #70707c, check mark in #3ddc97; wordmark 150px weight 500; soft vignette
en.prompt: Build a terminal title card called Rhythmic Typing. Near-black background (#09090c) and one line of JetBrains Mono at 56px with a solid white block cursor following the end. Type '> add backoff to webhook retries' character by character with uneven gaps of 0.04 to 0.11s and 0.3 to 0.5s pauses between words, including a typo ('bakcoff') that you fix with five backspaces at 0.04s each. Hold 0.7s, delete the whole line at 0.022s per character, wait 0.5s, then type a green check mark and '214 tests passing', hold 0.4s, delete at 0.015s per character, and type the wordmark at 150px. The cursor is solid on every keystroke and blinks 0.5s on and 0.5s off during idle gaps. Characters are hard sets with no fade. Behind the line, a list of 15 feature names at 13% opacity scrolls up 380px, and at the end the cursor turns green as a tagline appears. The whole piece runs 11 seconds with a slow scale drift of 1 to 1.04.
says: Typed out one character at a time like a terminal
Typed, deleted, then a new line typed
The cursor blinks and the typing speed keeps changing
vs: Word-by-Word Highlight brightens words and never deletes; Rhythmic Typing appends characters and has a cursor and delete-and-retype.
Prompt Carousel happens inside an input box with several prompts scrolling vertically; Rhythmic Typing is a single line of text.

en.title: Typing Animation (Typewriter Effect): Recipe and Code
en.description: Monospace text types at uneven human speed, fixes a typo with backspaces, then deletes and retypes. Make it with Claude Code or Codex from the free recipe.
en.lede: Monospace text is typed character by character with a cursor at uneven human speed, then deleted and retyped.
en.name: Typing Animation (Typewriter Effect)

body.h2: How to make a Typing Animation (Typewriter Effect) with Claude Code or Codex
body.body:
Anchor a left-aligned line at x 240 px in JetBrains Mono 56 px on #09090c, with a 33.6 x 66 px white block cursor at the end of the text. Each character is an opacity hard set (tl.set) on a fixed 33.6 px grid with no tweening. Gaps between characters run 0.04 to 0.11 s, with 0.3 to 0.5 s pauses between words.

Build in a typo: 'bakcoff' typed at 1.2 s, five backspaces at 0.04 s each from 2.1 s, then the retype. Deleting is much faster than typing: 32 characters in 0.69 s. The cursor stays solid on every keystroke and blinks 0.5 s on and 0.5 s off in idle gaps. At 9.43 s it turns green (#3ddc97) as the tagline appears.

Press the copy button on the recipe page and paste it into Claude Code or Codex, or run npx skills add krisyangdev/motionboard. The agent renders an MP4 with HyperFrames, or ports the GSAP timeline to your site with your own command line, status text and wordmark.

en.alt: A terminal prompt typing "add backoff to webhook retries" beside a faded column of feature names.
faq: What is a typing animation (typewriter effect)?
Text appears one character at a time, usually with a cursor at the end of the line, imitating keystrokes. More realistic versions vary the speed, pause between words and backspace over mistakes.
How do I make typing look human?

Vary the delay between characters within a range, here 0.04 to 0.11 s, which is about 9 to 25 characters per second. Add longer pauses between words (0.3 to 0.5 s) and delete much faster than you type. Seed the random jitter so every render is identical.
Is the Typing Animation (Typewriter Effect) recipe free to use?

Yes. Motionboard is free and MIT licensed, so you can use and modify the recipes and the films they produce in personal and commercial projects. The licence asks only that copies of the recipe files keep the copyright notice.

body.h2: 用 Claude Code 或 Codex 做打字机动画
body.body:
在 #09090c 的背景上，把一行左对齐文字锚定在 x 240px，用 JetBrains Mono 56px，末尾跟一个 33.6 x 66px 的白色方块光标。每个字符是一次 opacity 硬切（tl.set），落在 33.6px 的固定网格上，不做补间。字符间隔 0.04 到 0.11 秒，词与词之间停 0.3 到 0.5 秒。

加入一次打错：1.2 秒打出 'bakcoff'，从 2.1 秒起每 0.04 秒退格一次，共五次，再重打。删除比打字快得多，32 个字符只用 0.69 秒。每次按键时光标实心，空闲间隙里 0.5 秒亮、0.5 秒灭，9.43 秒标语出现的同一帧光标变成绿色（#3ddc97）。

在配方页点复制按钮，粘贴给 Claude Code 或 Codex，也可以运行 npx skills add krisyangdev/motionboard 安装技能。智能体会用 HyperFrames 渲染 MP4，或者把 GSAP 时间线移植到你的网站，换成你自己的命令行、状态文字和字标。

zh.alt: 终端里正在输入 add backoff to webhook retries，旁边是一列淡出的功能名。
faq: 文字一个字符一个字符地出现，行尾通常带光标，模仿敲键盘。更真实的版本会改变速度、在词间停顿，还会退格修改错字。
怎样让打字看起来像真人？
让字符间隔在一个范围内变化，这里是 0.04 到 0.11 秒，约每秒 9 到 25 个字符；词间加 0.3 到 0.5 秒的停顿，删除速度明显快于打字。随机抖动用固定种子，保证每次渲染结果一致。
打字机动画配方可以免费使用吗？
可以。Motionboard 免费，使用 MIT 许可证，你可以在个人和商业项目里使用、修改配方和它生成的视频。许可证只要求复制配方文件时保留版权声明。
